Lower half=[4, 7, 7, 10, 13]; its middle is Q1=7. Upper half=[13, 16, 19, 22, 25]; its middle is Q3=19. Minimum=4, maximum=25; range=21; IQR=19−7=12. Draw whiskers and the box at those actual scale values. Answer: five-number summary = (4, 7, 13, 19, 25). The box covers the middle 50% of the ordered observations.
